candidate_set: all prefit-admitted mapped SNPs with finite mutant/WT effects and >=2 matched positive CPM replicate pairs; no outcome sign/range filtering

coefficient_comparison.gauge: subtract grand mean; secondary remove row/column additive terms
coefficient_comparison.scope: descriptive feature-label permutations; no causal or independent-context p-value

constant_prediction_spearman: operational no-ranking skill = 0, flagged not mathematical correlation
constant_target: stop parent ranking branch; keep status, never drop silently
parent_nuisance: centered training-parent indicators for all learned B feature models; unseen parent has all-zero nuisance features
stop_after: one A evaluation, locked B evaluation and prespecified diagnostics; no rescue or GSE334718 outcomes

strong_success.qualification: not pristine untouched; 7 elements, 5 overlap components, 2 genes; no breadth claim

target.effect: mutant processed normalized logFC minus matched exact 190nt WT processed normalized logFC
target.negative: SNP decreases that enrichment versus WT
target.normalization: log2(CPM+1) minus per-element-group fraction/replicate median; author REML mixed model fraction contrast
target.positive: SNP increases synaptoneurosome input relative to cortical input versus its WT

test_a_primary_metric: mean parent Spearman signed rank correlation
test_b_inner: same parent/overlap exclusion within outer training only
test_b_inner_selection: mean parent MSE; ties prefer larger alpha
test_b_outer: leave-one-parent-out, purge all overlapping same-gene parent intervals from training
test_b_secondary_outer: leave-one-gene-out for simple_full and simple_full_delta2 only; fixed alpha10; two genes descriptive
